meta.one_liner: Buy SPY and QQQ on 15-minute dips stretched below the session VWAP, sell the snap back to it.
meta.explainer_md: VWAP — the volume-weighted average price of the session so far — is the intraday trader's center of gravity: institutions benchmark their fills against it, so price tends to gravitate back toward it. This strategy watches 15-minute bars on SPY and QQQ and buys when price gets stretched 0.3% or more below the session VWAP with a washed-out fast RSI, betting on the snap back. It exits the moment price reclaims VWAP, or via a 1% stop / one-day limit if the snap-back never comes. The engine computes VWAP fresh each session from the 15-minute bars (extended hours included), so the anchor resets every day.

spec.name: VWAP Reversion (15m)
spec.description: 15m bars: close 0.3%+ below session_vwap with rsi_3 washed out; exit on VWAP reclaim, 1% stop.
